summary.label: Above 2%
summary.text: Prices are up 3.7% from a year ago, at a 4.6% yearly pace over the last 3 months. The Fed's own measure (core PCE) is 3.0%, above its 2% goal.

summary.label: No signal
summary.text: The job market looks solid: unemployment 4.2%, about 198K weekly claims.

summary.label: Near 10-yr high
summary.text: Mortgages cost 7.32%, higher than 98% of weeks in the last 10 years. Yield curve: normal.

summary.label: Normal
summary.text: Markets are steady (VIX fear gauge at 16.7).

summary.label: Near 10-yr high
summary.text: Brent oil is $115, higher than 96% of days in the last 10 years. Down 3.7% over the past month.

indicators.name: Brent crude oil
indicators.about: The global oil benchmark. It feeds into fuel, shipping, airline and food costs worldwide, usually within weeks.

status.label: Near 10-yr high
status.text: Higher than 96% of readings in the last 10 years. Down 3.7% over the past month.

indicators.name: Inflation (CPI)
indicators.about: How much US consumer prices rose over the past 12 months: the inflation number in the news. The Fed's 2% goal is set on a related measure (PCE, see "Core PCE inflation"). Seasonally adjusted; the latest month can be revised.

status.label: Above 2%
status.text: Prices are up 3.7% from a year ago. Speeding up: the last 3 months ran at a 4.6% yearly pace.

indicators.name: Core inflation (CPI)
indicators.about: CPI without food and energy, which swing a lot, so it shows the underlying trend.

status.label: Above 2%
status.text: Prices excluding food and energy are up 2.6% from a year ago. Speeding up: the last 3 months ran at a 3.4% yearly pace.

indicators.name: Core PCE inflation
indicators.unit: % vs a year ago, Fed's measure
indicators.about: The measure the Federal Reserve's 2% goal is set on: personal consumption prices without food and energy. It covers more spending than CPI and is published a few weeks later.

status.label: Above goal
status.text: Prices excluding food and energy are up 3.0% from a year ago (the Fed aims for 2%). Cooling: the last 3 months ran at a 2.0% yearly pace.

indicators.name: US gas price
indicators.about: Average price of regular gasoline at the pump across the US.

status.label: Near 10-yr high
status.text: Higher than 95% of readings in the last 10 years. Down 0.8% over the past month.

indicators.name: Natural gas (US)
indicators.about: Henry Hub spot price. Drives heating and electricity bills. Very spiky in cold snaps.

status.label: Typical
status.text: Higher than 65% of readings in the last 10 years. Up 4.4% over the past month.

indicators.name: World food prices
indicators.about: IMF index of global food commodity prices. Spikes hit poorer countries hardest and have triggered unrest.

status.label: High
status.text: Higher than 84% of readings in the last 10 years. Up 0.8% since the previous month.

indicators.name: Recession signal (Sahm rule)
indicators.about: Compares the 3-month average unemployment rate with its lowest point in the past year. A rise of 0.5 has marked the start of every US recession since 1970. It fired falsely in 2024, so treat it as a warning light, not proof.

status.label: No signal
status.text: Unemployment (3-month average) is at its lowest level of the past year. At 0.5 this has flagged every US recession since 1970, plus one false alarm in 2024.

indicators.name: Jobless claims
indicators.about: People filing for unemployment each week. The fastest signal of layoffs. The 4-week average smooths out holiday noise.

status.label: Healthy
status.text: About 198K new unemployment claims a week. Under 250K signals a healthy job market. Down 3.1% over the past month.

indicators.name: Unemployment rate
indicators.about: Share of people who want a job but can't find one.

status.label: Steady
status.text: 4.2% of people who want a job can't find one. That's down 0.2 pts from a year ago.

indicators.name: Copper price
indicators.about: "Dr. Copper": used in construction, cars and factories, so it tracks global industrial demand.

status.label: Near 10-yr high
status.text: The highest in the last 10 years. Up 1.0% since the previous month.

indicators.name: Fed interest rate
indicators.about: The Federal Reserve's policy rate. Sets the cost of borrowing across the economy. See the odds panel for what markets expect next.

status.label: Recently raised
status.text: The Fed's key rate is 3.88%. Up 0.25 pts in the last 3 months.

indicators.name: 10-year Treasury yield
indicators.about: What the US government pays to borrow for 10 years. Drives mortgage and business loan rates.

status.label: Near 10-yr high
status.text: Higher than 99% of readings in the last 10 years. Up 0.17 pts over the past month.

indicators.name: Yield curve (10y minus 2y)
indicators.about: The gap between long and short-term rates. Below zero (inverted) has come before most US recessions, often by a year or more. It doesn't predict timing.

status.label: Normal
status.text: Long-term rates are above short-term ones, the normal healthy shape.

indicators.name: 30-year mortgage rate
indicators.about: Average rate on a new 30-year fixed mortgage in the US (Freddie Mac survey).

status.label: Near 10-yr high
status.text: Higher than 98% of readings in the last 10 years. Up 0.37 pts over the past month.

indicators.name: US dollar index
indicators.about: Dollar vs a basket of major currencies. A strong dollar makes imports cheaper for Americans but squeezes other countries that borrow in dollars.

status.label: High
status.text: Higher than 79% of readings in the last 10 years. Up 2.1% over the past month.

indicators.name: VIX fear gauge
indicators.about: How big a swing investors expect in US stocks over the next month. Under 20 is normal, over 30 is fear.

status.label: Normal
status.text: At 16.7. Under 20 is normal; over 30 means investors are scared. Up 12.2% over the past month.

indicators.name: Gold
indicators.about: Safe-haven asset that tends to rise when people are worried. Priced via the PAX Gold token, which is backed by one ounce.

status.label: Low
status.text: Lower than 92% of readings in the last year. Down 7.5% over the past month.

indicators.name: Bitcoin
indicators.about: A gauge of speculative risk appetite. Very volatile.

status.label: Typical
status.text: Higher than 63% of readings in the last year. Down 6.1% over the past month.
